cases.name: Brandi Howell Whitt
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Brandi was a 1995 graduate of Etowah High School. She loved hobbies, crafts, and doing floral designs. Above everything, Brandi loved to spend time with her son, Brantley. He was her entire world. She also was a loving stepmom."
